title: docs: the skills sync is taught without `--copy`, so a project that commits its skills hands every clone dangling links into the gitignored `node_modules`
body:
Filing gate **①**: a published instruction that leaves the reader with a broken result. The landing points are named below.

`reach:` measured once, by #22659's dev (`os-dev-report` `6144849147`, `installer_choice` row 1). They ran the documented `npx skills experimental_sync --agent claude-code -y` with `skills@1.7.2`, in a throwaway project that had installed the PUBLISHED `@objectstack/skills@18.0.0-next.0` (npm, and again with pnpm). The command wrote 10 symlinks under `.agents/skills/` pointing into `node_modules`, plus 10 symlinks under `.claude/skills/` pointing into `.agents`, and 0 real `SKILL.md` files. `node_modules` is gitignored, so a project that commits its skills (as a scaffolded project does) hands every clone dangling links. With `--copy`, the same command wrote 10 skills as 64 real files and no symlinks. #23248's contract-review record `6145120134` escalated it to be filed, because its intended carrier, #22668, is closed.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes it. The pages are `domain:devx` docs plus the two skills READMEs. The scaffolder itself is already right: PR #23248 runs `--copy`, and the `AGENTS.md` it writes says to keep `--copy`.

## Where the linked form is taught (read on `origin/main`)

- `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:24`
- `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx:33`
- `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx:65`, `:431`
- `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx:52`, `:359`
- `packages/skills/README.md:31`
- `skills/README.md:12`

Two of the pages (`build-with-claude-code.mdx` about `:60`-`:67` and `your-first-project.mdx` about `:47`-`:54`) also describe the scaffolder "Through 18.0.0-next.0" as installing from GitHub `main`. Once PR #23248 ships, they need a line for the versions after it: the scaffolder installs the package's catalog itself.

## Acceptance

- Every instruction that tells a reader to sync the package catalog into a project gives `--copy`, as the scaffolder does. Where the linked form is the right one (a project that does not commit its agent directory), the page says so in one sentence instead of making it the default.
- The two "Through 18.0.0-next.0" passages gain the post-#23248 behaviour.
- ⛔ No change to the scaffolder: PR #23248 is the source the docs follow.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `skills experimental_sync without --copy symlinks into node_modules dangling links docs committed project` gives 4 hits (#15763, #17046, #11464, #11317). All are closed and none is this. #22668 (closed `completed`) shipped the package-based docs this card corrects.
